description: DELETE /v2/vpcs/{vpc_id} answers 409 `Can not delete VPC with members` while a droplet, cluster or database is still in the VPC, including for a while after a member was destroyed (live response, alchemy DigitalOcean Vpc suite). The spec lists only 401/404/429/500. Type it as VpcHasMembers so a delete can wait for the members to leave.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The VPC still has members (409 `Can not delete VPC with members`).
